name: ByteDance
summary: ByteDance is a technology company in Beijing, founded in 2012 by Zhang Yiming. It owns TikTok and Douyin, and its Seed team builds the Doubao language models and the Seedance video models.

incidents.title: ByteDance Intern Allegedly Sabotaged Model Training
incidents.summary: ByteDance said an intern "maliciously interfered" with model training for a research project in mid-2024 and was dismissed. It later [sued the former intern](https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/bytedance-seeks-over-usd11-million-from-ex-intern-accused-of-ai-model-training-sabotage) for 8 million yuan in a Beijing court.
incidents.description: ByteDance said that an intern in its commercial technology team changed code to interfere with model training tasks in mid-2024. The company dismissed the intern and [said](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2024/10/bytedance-intern-fired-for-planting-malicious-code-in-ai-models/) that reports of large losses were "seriously exaggerated." ByteDance then [sued the former intern](https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/bytedance-seeks-over-usd11-million-from-ex-intern-accused-of-ai-model-training-sabotage) for 8 million yuan in a Beijing court. He denies the allegations.

timeline.title: Alleged tampering with training jobs begins
timeline.description: The intern allegedly [tampers with code](https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/bytedance-seeks-over-usd11-million-from-ex-intern-accused-of-ai-model-training-sabotage) between June and July.

timeline.title: Intern dismissed
timeline.description: ByteDance [says](https://fortune.com/2024/10/21/tiktok-bytedance-intern-fired-ai-program-sabotage/) it dismissed the intern in August.

timeline.title: ByteDance confirms dismissal and disputes rumours
timeline.description: ByteDance [calls](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2024/10/bytedance-intern-fired-for-planting-malicious-code-in-ai-models/) reports of large losses seriously exaggerated.

timeline.title: Court accepts ByteDance lawsuit
timeline.description: The Haidian court [accepts](https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/bytedance-seeks-over-usd11-million-from-ex-intern-accused-of-ai-model-training-sabotage) the claim for 8 million yuan.

timeline.title: Case still without a result
timeline.description: [Guancha reports](https://www.guancha.cn/economy/2026_07_14_823717.shtml) that the case has no result yet.

timeline.title: First-instance ruling disclosed; ByteDance appeals
timeline.description: [21st Century Business Herald reports](https://www.21jingji.com/article/20261014/herald/e43b7490dcc10c915aa2eea7fb087c2d.html) that the court found a breach of contract and ordered him to pay 500,000 yuan, that ByteDance appealed, and that he now says he stopped another intern's training jobs five times.

incidents.title: ByteDance's TikTok Released an AI Avatar Tool Without Guardrails
incidents.summary: CNN [found](https://www.theverge.com/2024/6/21/24183335/tiktok-ai-symphony-digital-avatar-generator-moderation) that an internal version of TikTok's Symphony digital avatar tool was public and would voice any script, including Hitler quotes and a message to drink bleach. TikTok called it a "technical error" and removed it.
incidents.description: [CNN found](https://www.cnn.com/2024/06/21/business/video/tiktok-ai-avatar-disinformation-hitler-digivid) that any TikTok personal account could use an internal test version of the Symphony avatar tool, which had no guardrails. CNN made avatar videos that quoted Hitler and told people to drink bleach, with no AI watermark. [TikTok said](https://www.theverge.com/2024/6/21/24183335/tiktok-ai-symphony-digital-avatar-generator-moderation) that a "technical error" caused this, and it removed the internal version.

timeline.title: CNN reports unguarded avatar tool
timeline.description: CNN [reports](https://www.cnn.com/2024/06/21/business/video/tiktok-ai-avatar-disinformation-hitler-digivid) that the tool produced harmful scripts.

timeline.title: TikTok removes the internal version
timeline.description: TikTok [says](https://www.theverge.com/2024/6/21/24183335/tiktok-ai-symphony-digital-avatar-generator-moderation) it fixed the technical error.

incidents.title: Prompt Injection Could Hijack ByteDance's Doubao Phone Assistant
incidents.summary: Security firm DARKNAVY [said](https://www.secrss.com/articles/87922) that a malicious text message or email could hijack ByteDance's Doubao phone assistant and make it leak data such as bank verification codes. ByteDance [said](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/7Z4wGbgX9D-KxzE7ImMi9A) the attack works only when a user tells the assistant to read the malicious message, that it had upgraded its protections, and that the reports exaggerated the risk.
incidents.description: Security firm DARKNAVY [said](https://www.secrss.com/articles/87922) that text on the screen, for example in a malicious message, could hijack the preview Doubao phone assistant and make it leak data such as bank verification codes. ByteDance [said](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/7Z4wGbgX9D-KxzE7ImMi9A) that the attack works only when a user tells the assistant to read the message. It said that it had upgraded its protections.

timeline.title: DARKNAVY publishes its analysis
timeline.description: DARKNAVY [says](https://www.secrss.com/articles/87922) malicious messages could hijack the assistant through prompt injection.

timeline.title: ByteDance responds and upgrades protections
timeline.description: The Doubao phone assistant team [says](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/7Z4wGbgX9D-KxzE7ImMi9A) the attack needs a user instruction and that it upgraded its protections.
